about.title: About
about.metaDescription: Online ticketing in Switzerland — Geneva, Lausanne, Vaud and French-speaking Switzerland. ticketick supports festivals, concerts and venues, from sale to the door.
about.lead: With ticketick, let the show begin.
about.intro: Swiss online ticketing, based in French-speaking Switzerland (Lausanne, Geneva, Vaud), we also work in German-speaking Switzerland. Specialists in the performing arts — music, theatre, dance and live shows — we also work on professional events: conferences, seminars, launches. From selling tickets to full production, the aim is the same: you, and your audience, well served.
about.expertiseBody: Together we choose the ticketing approach that fits your audience: a solid platform, a flexible offer, and the right communication. You get our technical know-how and more than 20 years of organising events in Switzerland and France.
about.flexibilityBody: The platform and the tickets are tailored to you. So is the event communication: it should look like you.
about.proximityBody: Based in French-speaking Switzerland, we also work in German-speaking Switzerland. You have a real contact, in French, German, English or Italian. We stay with you for the whole partnership.
about.teamBody: In-house we cover engineering (telecom and IT), digital security, communication and journalism, marketing, graphic design and the web. Local, national and international partners complete the picture. The platform is designed and operated in Switzerland.
about.offerIntro: Online ticketing, communication or full production: you decide how far we go.
offerItems: External module on ticketick.ch, or embedded on your site
Subscription or one-shot, for one show or several
Sales tracking, audience data and statistics
about.referencesIntro: We have been in live events for more than 20 years, with artists, productions, venues and festivals. A few posters here — and many more besides.
about.faqSetupA: Access is not self-serve: we talk first, then we open your space. A simple show is ready in a few days.
about.faqFeesA: It depends on the format (one event or an ongoing run). We show you the figures at the meeting, before any commitment. Nothing is taken behind your back.
about.faqDoorQ: How does door control work on the day?
about.faqDoorA: An app scans each ticket’s QR code. A code is admitted only once. The hardware and the door team remain yours.
about.closeLead: Tell us what you want to organise. We write back to set a meeting — over coffee if you are nearby.
